title: General Physics II
description: Introductory algebra-based survey of physics including heat, sound, wave motion, light, electricity, magnetism, and modern physics. Life Science applications.
notes: Not open for credit to students registered in or with credit in any of PHYS 102, PHYS 111, PHYS 112, PHYS 125, PHYS 130.
recommendations: One of MATH 100, MATH 102, MATH 109 recommended prior to or in conjunction with PHYS 102B.
